work.title: Ouverture og scenemusik til Chr. K.F. Molbech's Drama "Dante"
Overture and Incidental Music to Chr. K.F. Molbech's Drama "Dante"

history.p: Molbech had written his play "Dante" as early as in 1851, but the director of The Royal Theatre, Johan Ludvig Heiberg, had refused to stage it. After the succes of "Ambrosius" in 1878 Molbech shortened and revised his text, and thirty seven years after the play had been rejected it was finally performed at The Royal Theatre. Apart from the new overture, Hartmann's incidental music is identical to some of his music to Hans Christian Andersen's "Maurerpigen" (HartW 15) from 1840. This play had only been performed a couple of times; "Dante" received eleven performances.

physDesc.physMedium: In stiff black binding with text: "J.P.E. Hartmann / Ouverture / til / Dante." Paginated in upper right/left-hand corner. Pages 1-47: Overture (autograph). Paper: 20 staves. End-dated: "29 Febr. 1888"; p. 48 blank; pp. 49-68: "II Ved Laugenes Optog" (copy). Paper: 18 staves; pp. 69-72: "III Forspil til 5te Akt" (copy, with autograph pencil additions in the viola part). Paper: 18 staves; p. 73 blank; pp. 74-80: "I Dandsemusik bag Scenen i Folko Portinaris Have" (copy). Paper: 18 staves. The titles of the incidental music are written in purple ink in Hartmann's hand.

Bound in blue cardboard with black spine. On the front cover a handwritten label inscribed: "Dante / Partitur". In upper left-hand corner label inscribed "830". Written in black ink. Paper: 16 staves (first 8 pages) and 18 staves. Overture and No. 2 paginated separately. No. 3 (4) unpaginated. At the beginning of each number a folio with the preceding lines of the actors.

annot.p: Comprises: Overture, Nos. 2 & 3 (here called No. 4) only.
